result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalks and signal control, but pedestrians must cross a wide, multi-lane roadway without a median refuge. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long exposure distance and lack of physical separation from traffic reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no physical island or median for pedestrians to wait safely if they cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the main roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with marked zebra crosswalks and traffic signals within a mixed-use residential area. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the presence of parked cars near the crossing reduce visibility and safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal poles at the intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt near the crosswalk and curb ramp shows signs of cracking and wear, which could be a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and near the curb ramp on the right.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads with Countdown
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic legal priority for walkers. However, the wide roadway design and lack of physical traffic calming measures result in long exposure distances and potentially high vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide expanse of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk across the primary roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or vertical element between the sidewalk and the roadway at the corner to protect waiting pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner curb area near the fire hydrant

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a vertical buffer, reduce the perceived width of the road, and encourage slower driving speeds.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and signals, but lacks physical protection for those crossing the wide multi-lane roadway. The absence of a median refuge or curb extensions increases exposure to vehicle traffic across a significant distance.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Protection
hazards.description: The wide intersection lacks curb extensions or bollards to protect pedestrians at the corners and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing on the wide roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing markings to high-visibility ladder or zebra patterns to increase driver awareness.
